rows.en: "Kujaku" and "Condor", huh... For now, it's smarter to let OOO use them.
Obtained the "Kujaku Medal" and "Condor Medal". OOO can now use a new skill.
Hmph, to think intruders were allowed in this far... Blast that Garagaranda, what was he doing?
So ya finally showed up? You squid bastard!!
I'd like to deal with you lot here myself, but the Shocker Greeed is nearly complete.
With our Shocker technology, the Core Medals have evolved to the next stage.
Before long, you too shall witness that threat with your own eyes.
I can't let you guys do whatever you want any longer!!
Greeed, schmeed! Me, I'm GREAT from start to finish, y'know?
Like I'd let you do that!! I'll never forgive you people!!
I won't let you have your way any longer!
Shocker Greeed or whatever, I don't care! I'm not forgiving you people!!
Hmph!! Save that smart mouth for after you've taken my meteor attack!!
Ngh...!! This attack is seriously bad news...!!
Whoaaah!! Whoa, whoa, whoa... Hey! That was dangerous, dammit!!
What!! This attack...!! A meteor drop...!!
Whoa...!! Damn it!! What an attack!!
What!! He's dropping meteors on us...!!
Guah...!! ...It's no good, the attack's too fierce!!
Gwaaah!! He's dropping meteors...!! ...What tremendous destructive power...
Ngh...!! Is that a meteor drop...!? What destructive power...!!
Ngh...!! A meteor drop...!? What destructive power...!!
Heh heh heh heh... Farewell!! Heh heh heh heh, hahahahahaha...!!
Wait...!! Ngh... We let him get away!!
Ngh... We let him get away.

notes.note: Continues the no-OOO branch from story_097 (#0.67-70): Ankh decides OOO should have the Kujaku/Condor medals for now; system message identical to #0.57.
Ikadevil grumbling about Garagaranda (absent); he/him per glossary g=m. Ikadevil uses old-man 'washi' and 'kisama' - kept gruff/haughty.

Leader blocks #0.77-91, #0.97-111, #0.114-128, #0.130-144, #0.147-154 (continues to #0.161 in story_099) voiced by wording only. Slot 3 in each block is clearly Den-O/Momotaros (squid bastard, Greeed/GREAT pun, 'abunee'). Identical Japanese -> identical English.
'Ika yarou' rendered 'squid bastard' at full strength.
'Hiiro-domo' is contemptuous; rendered 'you heroes' with Ikadevil's sneering tone.
Subject restored as 'I' (leader speaking); 'we' would also work. #0.102/#0.111 'saseru mono ka' -> 'I won't let you!!'.
Momotaros pun: dismisses 'Greeed' and says he's 'great' from start to finish (riff on his 'climax from the start' line). Kept as Greeed/GREAT wordplay.
'Saseru ka yo' -> 'Like hell I will!!' (I won't let you), rough voice.
Row #0.113 absent from slice (probably the meteor attack effect).
'Inseki otoshi' rendered 'meteor drop' (echoes colony drop; likely Nu Gundam/Amuro slot). Ikadevil's meteor attack is from the original Kamen Rider.
Grunts distinguished by kana: lowercase 'gua' -> 'Gah', katakana 'gua' -> 'Guah', 'guwa' -> 'Gwah'.
'Torinigashita ka' rendered 'We let him get away' (party subject restored); Ikadevil = he.
Trailing full-width space in source dropped.
Unlabelled silence; probably Ankh, who reacts in #0.146. Rendered '......' as in earlier slices.

report: 80/80 rows translated. Leader-variant blocks voiced by wording (slot 3 = Momotaros). Uncertain: #0.97 'I' vs 'we'; #0.99 Greeed/GREAT pun; #0.145 silence assumed Ankh; 'meteor drop' coined for inseki otoshi. Not in glossary: Kujaku/Condor Medal (romanized as in story_097).
